title: Corrigendum to "Nonsymplectic automorphisms of prime order on O’Grady’s sixfolds"
claim_quote: p. 1, Abstract: "In this short note we correct the lattice theoretic classification in [3] of the first named author, including some missing cases and explaining how to recover them." p. 2, §2: "We give a complete list of corrections for [3, Tables 1, 2, 3, 4, & 5]." "In what follows, we describe the missing and erroneous cases in loc. cit., and we give corrected versions of [3, Tables 1, 2, 3, 4 & 5]." The numbered corrections on pp. 2–3 include missing lattice cases, duplicate entries, and an erroneous entry with no primitive extension.
corrected_paper: Nonsymplectic automorphisms of prime order on O’Grady’s sixfolds
rationale: correcció significativa / fora d'abast de patches (producte): la correcció refà la classificació lattice-theoretic, afegeix casos absents, elimina duplicats, corregeix una entrada i reprodueix cinc taules completes; és una revisió substancial, no un canvi textual petit. El paper de Grossi citat com [3] no coincideix amb Darmon, Greenberg o Zhang al repo.
